home.title: Mail Assistant Control Center
home.hero: Manage contacts, reusable files, templates, and AI-assisted outreach in one multilingual workspace.
home.cta: Choose a section from the navigation to begin.

contacts.title: Contact Management
contacts.description: Create, edit, or import contacts. Bulk import supports CSV files with name, email, company, and phone columns.

files.title: File Library
files.description: Upload up to ten reusable files and attach them to templates or outbound emails.

templates.title: Email Templates
templates.description: Define reusable scenarios with localized context, sample prompts, and default attachments.

compose.title: Compose Emails
compose.description: Draft personalized single or multi-send messages. Claude AI generates localized subject lines and email bodies.

intake.title: New Client Intake Form
intake.description: Capture leads from events or the web, trigger automatic follow-ups, and assign manual tasks.

settings.title: Workspace Settings
settings.description: Configure AI provider keys, mail provider credentials, localization preferences, and integrations.
